description: Asymmetric dual-app topology proven by both manifests and code: parent (cm.pt.barkparent 6.5.1) is React Native with a single MainActivity and 4 app Java files; child (com.pt.bark 7.26.0) is native Kotlin with VpnService + AccessibilityService + ONNX AI. Zero direct parent-child channel — cloud is the only mediator.
name: Dual-App RN+Native Topology (Parent RN / Child Kotlin)

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for splitting a thin parent console from a thick native child agent; Family OS adopts the same split with Device Owner on the child side.

description: PackageList.getPackages() registers exactly 20 native packages (MainReactPackage + 19): AsyncStorage, RNCConfig, ReactNativeBiometrics, ReactNativeOneSignal, RNIterableAPI, NitroIap, NitroModules, RNSentry, RNDeviceInfo, FBSDK, RNGestureHandler, RNReactNativeHapticFeedback, RNRate, SafeAreaContext, RNScreens, RNShare, RNCWebView, BlurView, RNCMaskedView. Zero Bark-owned custom native modules — all app logic is JS.
name: RN Bridge Package Map (20 Native Packages)

reusability_assessment.notes: Ready-made recipe for which native modules a parent-console RN app needs; adapt (drop Iterable, keep the rest).

description: RNCConfigModuleImpl.getConfig() reflects every field of cm.pt.barkparent.BuildConfig into a JS-readable map — the react-native-config pattern for shipping build-time env (API hosts, keys, feature flags) from native to JS without hardcoding them in the bundle.
name: RNCConfig Environment Bridge (BuildConfig Reflection)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the pattern for Family OS environment separation (dev/staging/prod) in any RN/hybrid surface.

description: Parent API uses GraphQL with Apollo persisted queries: the Hermes bundle contains graphql.persisted_query.hash.sha256Hash and graphql.persisted_query.version — clients send SHA256 fingerprints instead of query text. Endpoint URL and operation list are obfuscated (not recoverable as plaintext).
name: GraphQL Persisted Queries (Apollo SHA256)

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt for the Family OS API: bandwidth-saving and tamper-resistant; keep a query registry server-side.

description: Parent push stack: OneSignal (hardcoded Android/iOS IDs, BootUp/FCM/NotificationDismiss receivers, JS bridge events for userState/permission/foreground-display/in-app messages), Iterable (marketing email/push, channel 'General Notifications'), dual Sentry (self-hosted sentry.bark.us/22 native + o447951.ingest.sentry.io JS), Firebase project bark-android-parent.
name: Parent Notification Stack (OneSignal + Iterable + Dual Sentry)

reusability_assessment.notes: Conceptual reference only — Family OS builds its own push channel for child-data sovereignty; do not reuse the hardcoded IDs/keys.

description: ~140 www.bark.us deep-link pathPrefixes declared in the parent manifest form an expert-guidance content graph (cyberbullying, depression, suicidal_thoughts, predators, sexting, talk-to-kids, conversation-suggestions, what-bark-monitors, child-risk-survey...). Alerts deep-link into category pages — 'expert recommendations' are linked web content, not generated advice.
name: Expert-Content Deep-Link Graph (~140 bark.us Paths)

reusability_assessment.notes: Adapt the alert -> expert-article pattern; in Family OS the articles are fed by the father-agent.

description: Device-code pairing fully decoded: kid enters the parent-issued code (Account section of parent app); POST login with body {password: <code>, log: {data: {platform, version}, name: "child_app_login"}} — code travels in the password field; SignInResponse{parent, child, capabilities}; capability gates (checkins/polling/screenTime) cached; device registered via POST children/{child_id}/connections/android (name/device/uid). The same code gates uninstall and restricted-settings access.
name: Device-Code Pairing Flow (POST login, password=code)

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt as the Family OS family-device linking model; add code TTL and attempt rate-limiting (absent here).

description: Bark REST v2 fully inventoried: https://www.bark.us/api/v2/ (16 BarkApi endpoints: login, children CRUD, connection activation, activities/events/logs/inventories upload, locations, checkins, place events, versions), https://data.bark.us/ (locations), https://screentime.bark.us/ (devices/event + eventBatch). Auth: 'Authorization: Token token=<token>'. 60s timeouts; Retrofit2 + RxJava + Gson + OkHttp.
name: Bark REST v2 API (3 Hosts, Token Auth, 16 Endpoints)

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for endpoint inventory and host separation (admin REST vs high-frequency data vs screen-time events).

description: ~50 broadcast actions (bark.intent.action.*) and ~90 extras (bark.intent.extra.*): command actions (ENABLE_SCAM_DETECTION, ENABLE_EXPLICIT_MONITORING, ALLOW_BROWSING, EMERGENCY_CALL, RING, REQUEST_SHUTDOWN, START_LOCATION), scam intents routed to companion packages us.bark.guarddog / us.bark.messages, and bootstrap config with ~15 BOOTSTRAP_* extras carrying child/connection/parent-token/feature flags.
name: BarkBroadcasts Command Vocabulary (~50 Actions)

reusability_assessment.notes: Ready-made command vocabulary for a child agent; adapt with per-command signatures and non-exported receivers (theirs are exported — rejected).

description: OneSignal NotificationServiceExtension: silent push with additionalData.type == "attention" triggers attention mode (forced immediate location, ttl_in_seconds coerced to [0,1800], default 120); other silent pushes are swallowed (preventDefault) and trigger a geofence refresh worker; titled pushes render a notification opening LauncherActivity.
name: Attention Push + Geofence Refresh (OneSignal Extension)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the pattern verbatim including the TTL clamp and preventDefault() — ideal for parent-initiated live location.

description: ServerUpdate.run(): upload gated by isPermittedToUploadToServer() AND pollingEnabled AND not-already-uploaded (MessagesDB); synchronous POST connections/{connection_id}/activities with BarkMessage.convertToMap() (message + AI scores); 204/400 or 200/201/202 mark uploaded; SocketTimeoutException defers retry; 401 disconnects the session.
name: ServerUpdate Upload Pipeline (Gates + Idempotency)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the gate + idempotency + retry/401-handling structure for any child-to-cloud upload in Family OS.

description: First real on-device AI in the 8-app program: res/raw ships adultmediamobile_31_1724800699_fp32.ort (16.9MB adult-media image model), mobilemodel_1_1753905899.ort (17.6MB text classifier), mfaondevice_1_1234567890.onnx (50KB), tokenizer.json (742KB), tfidf_config.json (max_features 5000, ngrams 1-3); libonnxruntime.so runtime. Pipeline: HuggingFaceTokenizer -> TextClassificationEngine (input_ids/token_type_ids/attention_mask tensors -> OrtSession.run -> softMax -> ScoreResults). OTPClassifier adds TF-IDF short-code spam detection; ORTAnalyzer handles images; AnalysisManager formats {abusive/score/version/deleted} JSON.
name: On-Device AI Engine (ONNX Models + us.bark.sdk.analysis)

reusability_assessment.notes: The single most valuable take: copy the inference architecture (tokenize -> tensors -> softmax -> threshold) and train Family OS's own bilingual models.

description: Scam-text classifier taxonomy read verbatim: 12 labels (Bad Investments, Catfish / Romance, Charity Scams, Fake Emergency, Fake Tech Support / Virus & Malware, Gift Card, Impersonation of Family, Impersonation of Government, Lottery / Sweepstakes, Medicare / Medicaid Fraud, Wire Transfer / Credit Card, neutral) with a hardcoded 0.97 probability threshold and neutral-label rejection.
name: Scam Taxonomy (12 Labels, 0.97 Threshold)

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt the conservative precision-first policy (0.97 + neutral rejection); recalibrate thresholds on Family OS data and extend the taxonomy.

description: Dual-stack enforcement with zero DeviceAdmin: BarkVpnService (VpnService + TunnelVpn + DevicesRepository) for web filtering, BarkAccessibilityService for app/window monitoring. Uninstall protection via parent-issued device code (DeviceCodeActivity), not device administration.
name: VPN + Accessibility Dual-Stack Enforcement

reusability_assessment.notes: Architectural reference for the enforcement dual-stack; Family OS adds Device Owner beneath it and replaces the device-code uninstall gate with a password gate.

description: Billing via NitroIAP (com.margelo.nitro.iap) plus openiap (dev.hyo.openiap) for Google Play purchases; parent gate via ReactNativeBiometrics (com.rnbiometrics) with USE_BIOMETRIC + USE_FINGERPRINT permissions.
name: NitroIAP Billing + Biometric Parent Gate

reusability_assessment.notes: Pattern is sound; adapt SKUs to Family OS plans.

description: Documented vulnerabilities explicitly rejected for Family OS: (1) command broadcast receivers declared exported=true with no signature verification — any app can command the child agent; (2) hardcoded secrets in the parent (google_api_key, google_crash_reporting_api_key in strings.xml; OneSignal IDs and Sentry DSNs in bundle/BuildConfig).
name: Security Anti-Patterns Catalog (Explicitly Rejected)

reusability_assessment.notes: Family OS: non-exported receivers + per-command signatures; secrets from a settings server with certificate pinning.
